[/size][size=4]WHAT THIS MOD DOES:[/size][size=1]
[/size][/b]Exactly what it says on the tin, by adding a Queens Of The Stone Age tee to the game which is accessable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense.[/url]﻿﻿


[b][size=4]WHY THIS QOTSA SHIRT SPECIFICALLY?
[/size][/b]Honestly? It's personally one of my favourite albums of all time... and it was lowkey the easiest to throw together!
[size=4][b]

[/b][/size][size=4][b]WILL THERE BE MORE STYLES?[/b]
[/size]Totally! I'm planning on adding more Queens-Styled tees for this mod, and even making more mods for different band tees as a whole to keep the valley rocking.



[size=6][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
Of course, this mod REQUIRES the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense. 
[/url]

Unzip the file, and then place the aptly-named folder﻿ "[FS] Queens Of The Stone Age - Songs For The Deaf T-Shirt" inside of your StardewValley/mods folder.


All done - ezpz. Track this mod for even more styles... eventually.


[b]KEEP ROCKING!
[/b]- MITCHELL34290[/center]
